_comment: Selectors for each chat UI. When a provider reshuffles their DOM, fix it HERE - no code changes. Run `node calibrate.mjs <service>` to dump live candidates.
_concurrency: How many tabs run at once per service. Each tab is an independent conversation. Raise until the provider starts throttling; 6 is a sane start.

gemini._labels: picker aria-label: 'Open mode picker, currently <X>'. 'X Extended' = thinking ON; 'Gemini X' = thinking OFF.
gemini._upload: PRIMARY upload = CDP Input.dispatchDragEvent (a TRUSTED drag with real file paths). Synthetic new DragEvent() from page context is IGNORED by Gemini - tested against 10 different targets, zero attachments every time. The 'Upload & tools -> Files' menu is a flaky fallback. Readiness = one uploader-file-preview per file AND 'Uploading file' gone; the send button is enabled throughout and is NOT a readiness signal.
gemini._sources: Sources are NOT inline anchors: a browsing response has source chips but zero anchors in the body. The URLs live behind the message '...' menu -> 'View sources' (data-test-id=sources-menu-button), which yields text-fragment URLs (#:~:text=...) pinpointing the cited passage. `browsed` comes from chip count / the search transient; `sources` requires opening that panel. 'sources-list' is the collapsed carousel and is always empty - never read it.
gemini.searchTransient: Searching the internet|Searching the web|Pesquisando na internet|Pesquisando
gemini.moreButton: message-actions button[aria-label*='More' i], message-actions button[data-test-id*='more' i]
gemini._sourceFilter: Panel chrome links (Google product/sign-out links) have EMPTY link text; real sources always carry a title. Requiring a non-empty title is the robust filter - a host blocklist alone missed google.com.br/intl.
gemini._extraction: PRIMARY text extraction is the message Copy button + clipboard, which yields the ORIGINAL MARKDOWN: tables as pipe tables, LaTeX as $...$ source, code in ``` fences. innerText is materially worse - KaTeX renders as garbled glyphs ('t ^ 2 = C Q-(k-1)'), tables lose structure, code loses its fence. innerText is only the fallback. NOTE the clipboard is shared across tabs, so copy+read must hold a mutex.
gemini._generatedFiles: Gemini CAN emit real files. The response renders <generated-file> with a chip: img.file-icon-lr, div[data-test-id=file-name][title=<real filename>], div.file-type-lr, and a gem-button 'Open'. There is NO <a download> and no blob: href, so a search for download affordances finds NOTHING - that is why it is easy to conclude wrongly that no file was produced. 'Open' opens a Drive-style viewer overlay in the SAME page; its toolbar is div[role=button] (Print / Download / More actions), NOT <button>, so button[aria-label*=Download] only ever matches the code-block's 'Download code'. Clicking div[aria-label=Download] fires a genuine browser download. Verified: pediatric_anaesthesia_trial_data.csv, 422 bytes.
gemini._extensionsMarker: Gemini adds this class to structured-content-container when its code/extension tool ran. Checked across six probes: present for csvfile and computational thinking, absent for prose, tables, maths and plain code. It is the gate for looking for a file at all, so ordinary responses cost nothing.

chatgpt.stopButton: button[data-testid='stop-button'], button[data-testid='composer-speech-button-container'] ~ button[aria-label*='stop' i], button[aria-label*='Stop' i], button[aria-label*='Parar' i]

_dials: concurrency = how many real conversations run at once. That is the only throttle; there are no artificial sleeps. Completion is detected structurally (send button re-enables), which paces things naturally.
_models: Model ids at /v1/models. 'match' is a regex against the picker option text; keep it to the version number so it survives UI language changes. NOTE: Gemini can sometimes swap model mid-thread but it is unreliable, so each request opens a fresh chat and selects there.
